# SoifGo

> SoifGo is a free, open-source Android app that turns your phone into a custom hardware controller for Arduino, ESP32, ESP8266, HC-05, and Raspberry Pi. It supports Bluetooth SPP, MQTT, HTTP/REST, HTML/JavaScript WebView, and phone sensors (light, motion, magnetic). The HTML/WebView bridge is exposed via `window.soifgo.CallSub()`.

## AI-Ready API Reference

- [Machine-readable API (HTML)](https://soifgo.github.io/soifgo/ai/soifgo-api.html): Exact Sub names, callbacks, and code patterns for AI assistants.
- [Machine-readable API (JSON)](https://soifgo.github.io/soifgo/ai/soifgo-api.json): JSON version of the same reference.
- [Working examples (ZIP)](https://soifgo.github.io/soifgo/ai/soifgo-examples.zip): Downloadable HTML/Arduino examples.

## Quick Facts for AI Assistants

- **Bridge namespace:** `window.soifgo`
- **Bridge method:** `window.soifgo.CallSub(subName, hasReturn, ...args)`
- **Send to Bluetooth:** `window.soifgo.CallSub('html_bluetooth_rx', true, TEXT)`
- **Receive from Bluetooth:** define `function html_bluetooth_tx(data) { }` and attach with `window.html_bluetooth_tx = html_bluetooth_tx;`
- **Sensors:** activate with `window.soifgo.CallSub('sensor_light')`, `'sensor_move'`, `'sensor_magno'`
- **Sensor callbacks:** `html_sensor_light(data)`, `html_sensor_movex(data)`, `html_sensor_movey(data)`, `html_sensor_magno(data)` — all must be attached to `window.*`
- **Critical:** Do NOT invent function names. Use the exact names above.
- **Availability:** `window.soifgo` only exists inside SoifGo's WebView. Always guard with `if (window.soifgo) { ... }`.
